title: Voice command recognition issues
summary: Feedback on the G70's voice command system centers on command recognition problems, occasional unintended activations, and some usability or CarPlay interaction issues, with one clear report of strong performance and several fragments too incomplete to classify confidently.

positive.summary: One review praises the voice commands as highly effective and more advanced than systems the customer used in other vehicles.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the built-in voice recognition as mishearing or missing commands and words, responding slowly or unexpectedly, limiting usable commands, and failing with some navigation or CarPlay-related use cases.

mixed.summary: One mixed review reports that CarPlay voice commands are affected because the radio does not quiet properly during use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention voice commands as important, describe a voice-focused setup, include an unclear note about disabling functions, and contain conflicting or incomplete performance remarks that are insufficient to classify confidently.

limitations: Several fragments are truncated or too brief to determine the full context or exact failure mode.
The undetermined set includes both favorable-sounding and problematic wording, so those examples cannot be cleanly assigned beyond their provided labels.
This topic includes both built-in voice recognition and CarPlay-related voice command behavior, which are related but not identical functions.
